title: I built an AMV-inspired Brazilian phonk Dice Roguelite you can play anywhere
author: SignificanceTime6941
selftext:
I built an AMV-inspired dice roguelite where every good hand dares you to PUSH for a better one.

The core loop is that choice: take the score, or chase a higher hand type and grow the multiplier.

A hand scores on both dice combinations and matching colors. Between battles, you buy and modify effect dice, open packs, and merge abilities together—gradually turning a random Dice Bag into a build that can explode into absurd scores. Beat a target by enough and you also get a bonus draw for more shop money.

Our current tuning target is for roughly **60% of runs to beat the fourth boss at Battle 12**, and only **1% to beat all eight at Battle 24**.

The visual direction is inspired by anime AMVs and short-form edits, with an original Brazilian phonk soundtrack. It runs directly in the browser on desktop and mobile.

**Build notes**

* Design and mechanics: me + Fable
* Math and balance: GPT-5.6 Sol
* First playable build: Fable + GPT-5.6 Sol, about a week of spare-time work
* Latest major pass: Fable 5.2 + Astra, completed in one day
* VFX: PixiJS
* Art: GPT Image
* Music: original [Brazilian phonk from HowWorks](https://howworks.ai/music/brazilian-phonk)

The main lesson was simple: prove the smallest playable loop before producing dozens of abilities around it.

GODROLL is live on Nepenthe Play. [Try it free in your browser](https://nepentheplay.com/games/dice).
